title: Electric force magnitude
description: Essential: The response must state the magnitude of the electric force as Eq.

title: Electric force direction
description: Essential: The response must state the direction of the electric force is to the right, parallel to the field.

title: Magnetic force magnitude
description: Essential: The response must state the magnitude of the Lorentz force as Bqv.

title: Magnetic force direction
description: Important: The response must correctly apply a rule (e.g., left-hand rule) to determine the force direction as perpendicular and inward.

title: Force-law identification
description: Important: The solution should correctly identify the relevant force laws (F_electric = qE, F_magnetic = qvB) for each part.

title: Velocity-field geometry
description: Important: For the magnetic force, the solution should note the velocity and field are perpendicular, giving maximum force magnitude.

title: Direction reasoning
description: Optional: The response may include a brief justification for the magnetic force direction using a specific hand rule.

title: Confusing force formulas
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses F = qvB for the electric field or F = qE for the magnetic field.

title: Incorrect direction rule
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the right-hand rule for the positive charge's magnetic force direction.
